name: qa-command-center
description: QA toolkit for Claude Code that ships with the QA Command Center app: slash commands for test cases, bug reports and daily updates; skills for boundary-value test generation, QA reviews and pushing to GitHub; subagents that write, review and run tests and explain flaky tests; and hooks that check API response shape and severity values, check the app after each commit, recompute flaky tests after a run result, and keep the flake analyzer working until every top-10 flaky test has a hypothesis.
